device_label: 5 mm hybrid Si/LN MZM, inductively loaded slow-wave electrode, 1550 nm
il_onchip_includes: two 3 dB MMI couplers, wide-Si transition sections, narrow-Si hybrid section, LN-edge transitions (0.1 dB each assumed), electrode interaction loss (0.4 dB over 5 mm)
il_onchip_excludes: fiber-to-chip edge coupling (5.2 dB/facet, lensed fiber 2.5 um nominal MFD)
substrate: SOI: 150 nm Si on 3 um SiO2 on 725 um high-resistivity Si; LN film bonded on top, LNOI handle removed
cladding: air above LN and electrodes (Fig. 1(c,d)); CMP SiO2 about 40 nm between Si waveguide and LN
epitaxy_or_stack: Si handle / 3 um SiO2 / 150 nm Si strip (275 nm wide in hybrid section, 650 nm in transition) / CMP SiO2 about 40 nm / 600 nm x-cut LN (unetched) / Au electrodes directly on LN
modulation_format: none (small-signal EO S21 and Vpi characterization only)
notes: Hybrid mode: 2% of power in Si, 84% in LN (Fig. 1(d)); TE, x-cut, unetched LN. VpiL 3.1 V*cm is the average over 0.1-10 MHz of a trapezoid-overdrive measurement (Fig. 4(b), about 3.0-3.15 V*cm); wavelength of that measurement not stated; implied Vpi 6.2 V (3.1/0.5 cm), not entered. Bandwidth: abstract says greater than 110 GHz, body/Fig. 5 caption/Table 1 say measured 3 dB bandwidth of 110 GHz; the 3 dB level is reached at the 110 GHz limit of the stitched OSA/LCA data; response normalized near the lowest plotted frequency (about 1 GHz, reference not stated by the authors); same 110 GHz at 4 mW CW and 110 mW quasi-CW (1 us pulses, 100 us period). Theory (linear model) predicts about 156 GHz. Optical power: 110 mW (20.4 dBm) is the maximum on-chip peak power tested in the feeder waveguide, no EO degradation; edge couplers (not the MZM) were damaged above 150 mW. IL measured at 1 mW low power. ER is the mean of the unmodulated asymmetric-MZI fringes over 50 nm (max 31 dB at 1560 nm), FSR 2.3 nm. Drive and Vpi convention are inferred from the GSG geometry with one arm per 9 um gap (Fig. 1(a), 3(c)); authors do not state them. Z0 42 ohm (9 um gap) is stated without saying whether simulated or measured: not entered. RF index 2.34 at 110 GHz and ng 2.32 are simulated. Propagation loss 0.6 dB/cm (hybrid, cited from earlier work) and 0.8 dB/cm (transition) are in the text but not entered. Total chip 1.7 cm; hybrid region 1.4 cm; electrode 5 mm. Not reported: RF loss, ground electrode width, waveguide lateral position, bias, temperature.

device_label: 5 mm O-band MZM, ITO/Au composite electrode, 3 um ITO gap
electrode_metal: Au (1.4 um); inner ITO electrodes 180 nm
modulation_format: OOK 56/80/112 Gb/s; PAM4 112 Gb/s (56 GBd) and 224 Gb/s (112 GBd)
driver: SHF S804B driver (22 dB gain), Keysight M8199A 70 GHz AWG
notes: Vpi 2.04 V from a 100 kHz sawtooth sweep (Fig. 5(a)); VpiL 1.02 V*cm in abstract/Sec. 3.1, 1.024 in Sec. 1/Table 1 (2.04 V x 0.5 cm = 1.02). Measured at 1310 nm (O-band laser; wavelength explicitly given for IL). EO S21 reaches -3 dB at 108 GHz (Sec. 3.2, Fig. 6); the plotted trace ends near 110 GHz; reference frequency not stated and the trace has a +2 dB peak near 5 GHz; the paper also shows a CST-simulated S21. Insertion loss 2.9 dB at 1310 nm is stated as "measured insertion loss ... with 3-mm [sic, 3-um] TCO gap" with grating couplers; whether it is on-chip or fiber-to-fiber is not defined, so neither IL field is filled. ER entered is the dynamic eye ER at the highest rate (224 Gb/s PAM4, 1.98 dB); the other eyes give 5.34 (56 Gb/s OOK), 4.15 (80 Gb/s OOK), 2.81 (112 Gb/s OOK), 2.32 (112 Gb/s PAM4) dB, mapped in text order to Fig. 7(a)-(e). Authors attribute the low ER to asymmetric electrode absorption. 224 Gb/s PAM4 BER is below the HD-FEC threshold 3.8e-3 for received power above -13 dBm (Fig. 7(f)). Termination 23 ohm via gold wire. Film thickness 500 nm is ridge 260 nm + slab 240 nm (not stated directly). Au electrode gap 5 um, ITO gap 3 um; ITO n about 1.5 and k 0.0011 at 1310 nm, conductivity 477 S/m measured (400 S/m assumed in simulation). Not reported: signal/ground widths, BOX and cladding thickness, RF loss, Z0, n_rf, optical input power, temperature.

notes: Vpi measured at 1 MHz with a triangle waveform (Methods p.5). Push-pull GSG CPW electrodes stated (p.2). Plotted data run to about 40 GHz. Insertion loss: on-chip loss about 0.7 +- 0.2 dB/cm from varied-length 3 um gap devices (supplementary, wavelength not stated in main text); total about 15 dB fiber-to-fiber includes about 7 dB/facet lensed-fiber coupling (wavelength and exact definition not stated). ER about 21 dB (Fig. 2(b) inset, 1 cm, 3 um gap, static transmission sweep). RF loss entered is the derived 1.35 dB/cm/GHz^0.5 x sqrt(35 GHz); RF index 2.22 at 50 GHz and optical group index about 2.38 (VNIR) are simulated; Z0 is a design target (close to 50 ohm). Index mismatch about 0.17. MZM is an unbalanced amplitude modulator with Y-splitters (0.2 dB excess loss each).
